answer: The pearl register is checked at draw time, quill lists the eligible set, and wander seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 41 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 41 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 51 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
